context: Evaluates correct implementation of the chat history API endpoint from open-nof1.ai. The solution must use Prisma to query the Chat table with the correct model filter, include nested Trading records, apply correct ordering and limits, and return results in the expected JSON format.

checklist.name: Prisma Chat query
checklist.description: The solution queries the Chat table via the Prisma singleton from open-nof1.ai using findFirst or findMany with a filter for model: 'Deepseek'

checklist.name: Include Trading records
checklist.description: The query uses Prisma's include to fetch associated tradings with a take: 10 limit and orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }

checklist.name: Result ordering and limit
checklist.description: The Chat query uses take: 10 and orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' } to return the 10 most recent records

checklist.name: Response format
checklist.description: The response returns a JSON object with a top-level 'data' key containing the array of Chat records with their nested tradings
